title: ProductRequest
description: Product request restatement: the problem, expected_behavior, compatibility_risks, open_assumptions, and stories fields below. Place these fields directly as the tool input — no outer wrapper.

problem.description: One-sentence statement of the user's pain.

expected_behavior.description: Externally observable outcomes that prove the request was satisfied. Each item should be testable from outside the code.

compatibility_risks.description: Existing behaviour in the system that could break as a result of the change.

open_assumptions.description: Facts the agent assumed but could not verify from the supplied repo context.

stories.description: 1-4 user stories. Fewer is better. Split only when a story hides independently-testable behaviours.

id.description: Stable id like 'US-1', numeric suffix starting at 1.

title.description: Short verb phrase summarizing the story.

as_a.description: The role taking the action, e.g. 'API consumer', 'operator'.

i_want.description: The capability the role wants, in one sentence.

so_that.description: The business value, in one sentence.

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable bullets, each observable from outside the code: an HTTP response shape, a stored row, a log line, a test name. No 'refactor X' or 'clean up Y' criteria.
